messages:
Noelle: quick share 437 meet Rumi, our neighbor's pygmy goat in a tiny hoodie. insisted on supervising my keyboard. posted: rumi_hoodie.jpg
Chris: Rumi looks like he just got promoted to Lead Snack Officer 389 :joy:
Yara: that hoodie is craftsmanship. where do I apply for a goat mentorship program?
Kellen: honestly, Rumi has better WFH boundaries than I do. also 10/10 on the beard grooming.
Noelle: he sniffed the spacebar and gave a gentle headbutt approval so I shipped the PR.
Chris: caption contest: "When the sprint is done and the goat becomes your release manager" :tada:
Yara: caption: "Rumi: enforcing nap times and snack policies" :palm_tree:
Kellen: ops-bot, hypothetical: can miniature farm animals make a lobby cameo? would bring carrier and tiny leash.
ops-bot: Reminder: Pet visits require People Ops approval. For farm animals or livestock (including pygmy goats), prior sign-off is required. Transport in secure carrier; no free-roam indoors. Please include allergy check and a short behavior note when submitting the Pet Visit request at least 72 hours in advance.
Noelle: will reach out to People Ops if Rumi can do a supervised lobby hello. tiny leash and treats ready.
Chris: petition to make a "Bring Your Goat" day. also, who wants to be on goat-guard duty? :raised_hands:
Yara: volunteering as goat wrangler for moral support and treat distribution.
Kellen: same 44d but only if Rumi approves of my hoodie choice.
Noelle: poll time 5f3: Rumi visit preference? (1) quick lobby hello (2) desk cameo behind plexiglass (3) virtual cameo only (react 1/2/3)
